body.name: \mathcal H_{\mathrm{gap}}
body.def: A handle that follows a rank-\(r\) path whose smallest nonzero singular value collides with zero while larger singular values remain separated, calibrates singular-value thresholding from the orthogonal cell-score experiment, compares the selected-rank plug-in with Tikhonov stabilization targeted at the unregularized transported curve, and uses two contiguous paths through the colliding singular direction for impossibility.
